name: Water Walk
description:
Choose up to 10 willing creatures within short range. For the next hour, the chosen creatures can walk across liquid surfaces as if they were solid.

The creatures are not protected from any harm that may come from being in contact with a dangerous liquid, such as acid or lava. If you target a creature that is submerged in a liquid, it moves to the surface of the liquid at a rate of 60 ft per turn.
